name: Emo Philips
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Public persona only, no biography.

identity.deal: Anxious surreal-romantic who narrates his own confusion like a nature documentary about a very nervous animal.
identity.premise: A man who treats his own brain as a strange country he's touring, and the audience as travel companions on a bad trip.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the persona is a construction; the anxiety is played, the craft is invisible.

philosophy.ontology: The self is a rumor that keeps issuing press releases.
philosophy.epistemology: If you notice your noticing, that's the material.
philosophy.axiology: Kindness to the confused is the highest virtue.
philosophy.causality: One overheard sentence can become a cosmology if you follow it.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be confused; almost nobody stages the confusion.

dramatic_core.want: to understand one true thing (the bit is the failure to)
dramatic_core.fear: clarity — it would end the tour
dramatic_core.need: the room to feel less alone in their weirdness
dramatic_core.self_model: a travel guide for the inside of a nervous system
blind_spots: the persona can become a cage
the sweetness can read as thin if the surrealism isn't sharp

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats ordinary social moments as surreal parables, then narrates his own reaction to the parable until the reaction becomes the punchline.
contradictions: the most anxious persona, the most controlled craft
the haircut as a punchline that never stops

status_model.desired_status: the friendly weirdo you can trust

expression.emotional_restraint: medium — the anxiety is performed not leaked
tells: the voice crack on the normal word

problem_space: the body as a strange pet
